free.q: The meeting was called ___ due to the sudden strike.
free.e: 'Called off' means cancelled, which fits the sentence.

free.q: In what year did Nigeria gain independence from British colonial rule?
free.e: Nigeria became an independent nation on 1 October 1960.

free.q: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ aware of the change in schedule.
free.e: In 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the noun nearer to it, which is 'students' (plural).

free.q: She promised to look ___ her younger brother while their parents travelled.
free.e: 'Look after' means to take care of someone.
